<harm>
    <!-- written by harm-coi --emit-config (H10): RTL predicates with origin="rtl" -->
    <context name="default">
        <prop exp="cnt == 4'd0" loc="a, c, dt" origin="rtl"/>
        <prop exp="cnt == 4'd9" loc="a, c, dt" origin="rtl"/>
        <prop exp="en" loc="a, c, dt" origin="rtl"/>
        <prop exp="rst" loc="a, c, dt" origin="rtl"/>
        <coi file="<WORK>/coi.json" mode="filter" depth="exact"/>
        <template dtLimits="5D,3W,15A,-0.1E,U" exp="G({..#1&..}|-> P0)"/>
        <sort name="causality" exp="1-afct/traceLength"/>
        <sort name="frequency" exp="atct/traceLength"/>
    </context>
</harm>

<harm>
    <!-- written by harm-coi --emit-config (H10): RTL predicates with origin="rtl" -->
    <context name="default">
        <prop exp="cnt == 4'd0" loc="a, c, dt, 2, 3" origin="rtl"/>
        <prop exp="cnt == 4'd9" loc="a, c, dt, 2" origin="rtl"/>
        <prop exp="en" loc="a, dt" origin="rtl"/>
        <prop exp="rst" loc="a, dt" origin="rtl"/>
        <prop exp="wrap == (en && (cnt == 4'd9))" loc="c, 5" origin="rtl-relation"/>
        <prop exp="cnt == ($past(((cnt == 4'd9) ? 4'd0 : (cnt + 4'd1)), 1) & 4'd15)" loc="c, 7" origin="rtl-relation"/>
        <prop exp="$stable(cnt)" loc="c, 7" origin="rtl-relation"/>
        <prop exp="wrap" loc="a, c, dt, 1" origin="rtl"/>
        <prop exp="!wrap" loc="a, c, dt, 1" origin="rtl"/>
        <coi file="<WORK>/coi.json" mode="filter" depth="exact"/>
        <template dtLimits="5D,3W,15A,-0.1E,U" exp="G({..#1&..}|-> P0(1))"/>
        <template dtLimits="5D,3W,15A,-0.1E,U" exp="G({..#1&..}|=> P0(2))"/>
        <template dtLimits="5D,3W,15A,-0.1E,U" exp="G({$fell(rst)}|-> P0(3))"/>
        <template dtLimits="5D,3W,15A,-0.1E,U" exp="G({!rst}|-> P0(5))"/>
        <template dtLimits="1D,3W,3A,-0.1E,U" exp="G({..#1&..}|=> P0(7))"/>
        <sort name="causality" exp="1-afct/traceLength"/>
        <sort name="frequency" exp="atct/traceLength"/>
    </context>
</harm>
